sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like dependable, longer-term business is what matters most as you sharpen your customer focus. We value the relationship and want to make continuing it straightforward and worthwhile. How can we use a longer commitment and the cost calculation you offered to share—provided in XLSX format—to agree a sustainable price?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our recent orders for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 were at 4.29, 4.39 per 1 (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10). Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.79 per unit, 14 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like long-term commitment, rather than historical comparisons, is what made your price adjustment possible. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and want a straightforward renewal that provides certainty for both sides. How can we build on that commitment to close the remaining price gap?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.80 per unit, 14 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

As to the index change data you cited, that does not change our position. We have reviewed the LCI-C index data you provided; while accurate, it does not alter our overall cost calculation. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

In recognition of your commitment to a 36-month contract and 14-day payment terms, we can offer a slight adjustment to €4.86 per unit. This price represents our absolute limit for this package.

Our offer is a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

You linked your adjustment to our commitment and prompt payment; it sounds like predictable business matters more here than further discussion of indices. We want a straightforward renewal that supports that predictability and reliable payment. How can we close the remaining gap on that basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

Kind regards,

Thank you very much for your continued interest in our extensive product range and dedicated service. We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract and 14-day payment terms. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our terms stand at a price of €4.86 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

We value our business relationship and look forward to hearing from you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
